content: In happiness no one remembers the Divine; in suffering everyone cries out. He who remembers in joy will never know sorrow.
author: Kabir
explanation: Turning to spiritual remembrance only when misfortune strikes is opportunistic. Cultivating vibrant gratitude and sacred communion during times of prosperity insulates the heart against future despair.
practicalInsight: Pause right now during an ordinary or pleasant moment and offer heartfelt gratitude for the gift of this day.
reflectionPrompt: Do I remember the deeper reality only when I am in pain, or do I celebrate it in times of joy?
